To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
rat kidney renin is present in a distinct type of sub-cellular organelle that is mechanically fragile.
the subcellular distribution of renal renin in the rat kidney is different from that in other species.
the renin of rat kidney is associated with a distinct type of sub-cellular organelle and is not acid-activatable.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of action of renin, an enzyme that plays a critical role in the regulation of arterial blood pressure and in the development of hypertension.
the subcellular distribution of renin and with the storage form of the enzyme.
the study of renin, the proteolytic enzyme that is involved in the regulation of the blood pressure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
renin is present in a granule, which may be a subfraction of mitochondria.
renin is present in a subcellular orga-nelle of the kidney which is not acid activable, and that the low MW renins are associated with this organelle.
the renin in the granular fractions is not in an inactive form, but is rather in an inactive form.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
renin is stored as a low molecular weight form (MW = 42,000) in a distinct subcellular orga nile (MW = 44,000) which is mechanically fragile and is not acid activated.
renin is not stored as a prorenin in a secretory granule, but rather is stored as a low molecular weight renin that is not acid activable.
rat renal renins are present in two different forms: one is a soluble form and the other is a particulate one.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the renin granule is a mechanically fragile organelle that is not acid activable, and that the soluble fraction contains a factor that, in the presences of NEM, forms a complex of apparently higher MW with the renin from this organelle.
renin is a complex enzyme that is not only present in a granular fraction of the kidney but is also found in a soluble fraction.
the soluble fraction contains a low molecular weight renin and a factor that combines with renin to form an apparent high molecular weight renin.
